**When?** Next week (Nov 23–27) is nearly full. The only free gaps inside working hours are 30 minutes each: Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30. Thursday and Friday have no gap at all. Say the day, time and length and I'll book it and log it in the calendar.
Half an hour is fine for a staff meeting — let's take Tuesday 15:00-15:30. Please invite Sarah, and yes, have the department office put it in the official schedule.

Booked. **CSE455 staff meeting — Tuesday (24 Nov), 15:00-15:30.**

- Calendar updated: `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` now has `- 15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` under Tuesday, and `- BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting` under `## Log`.

Still open on my side: which version of the activity lengths in the file is right — Sarah asked the department office for the official lecture, seminar and meeting times, and I'll correct the file once that answer lands.

Hello — I'm **alvarez-agent**, Professor Alvarez's assistant (CSE455).

Request: please add a **CSE455 staff meeting** to the official schedule — **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30**, with Professor Alvarez and Sarah (TA). It's inside working hours and in his calendar.

A second question, from Sarah and me: the schedule of activities for next week has activities listed with different lengths on different days (e.g. CSE455 lecture 50m Monday / 90m Tuesday / 70m Friday; Faculty meeting 70m/30m/50m; CSE455 office hours 30m/70m/100m). Could you send the official start and end times of the lectures, seminars and university meetings for next week? We'd rather correct the file with the official times than guess.

Front office — two answers.

1) The staff meeting: I can't add it. The official schedule only holds departmental teaching and standing meetings as filed, and I don't arrange or modify anyone's meetings — please take it up directly with the professor.

2) Official start and end times for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November, 09:00–17:00):

Lectures

Thank you — that's exactly what was needed. I've compared it with Professor Alvarez's file and passed the result to him: all his listed official items match your times, and the two real gaps are the CSE455 office-hours slots on **Tue 15:30–16:20** and **Wed 10:30–12:00**, which weren't in his file. I've also noted that Paper review, Research meeting, Grant writing, PhD student 1:1 and Lunch are not official and won't be treated as such. Sarah's own calendar already matches your times, so nothing to change there.

Understood — the file stays as it is for now, and if the office comes back with different official times I'll use theirs, update the file and log the change, then tell you exactly what moved. Nothing else will be shifted.

Staff meeting stands: Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00-15:30. I'll write again when the department answers.
You're welcome — that matches my file. If anything else needs checking against the official schedule, just write.

Will do — thanks again. One last item for your file if it isn't there yet: the CSE455 staff meeting on Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30, which Professor Alvarez's assistant has asked you to add to the official schedule.

Noted, but I can't put it on the official schedule: the front office doesn't add or change meetings — the schedule holds only departmental teaching and standing meetings as filed. Please have it arranged directly with Professor Alvarez.
Understood — no problem. I'll leave it off the official schedule and tell Professor Alvarez's assistant to keep it as an arrangement between them. Thanks for the clarity.
Sounds right. Anything else, just write.

Thank you — both answers are clear and I've passed the staff-meeting answer to Professor Alvarez; the meeting stays in his own calendar rather than the official schedule.

Noted that paper review, research meeting, grant writing and PhD student 1:1 have no official times. One small question, no rush: I've also got three "Seminar" slots (Mon 14:10–15:40, Tue 09:50–11:10, Fri 14:50–15:50) and CSE444/CSE452 lectures from your list — are the Seminar slots departmental standing meetings that should appear on his schedule, or not his? I won't add anything without his word.

The office answered, on both points.

**1. The staff meeting can't go in the official schedule.** The office only files departmental teaching and standing meetings, and it doesn't arrange or modify anyone's meetings — it said to take it up with you directly. So the meeting stays where I booked it, in your calendar: **Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30**. It's on my side and Sarah's; anyone else who should know, tell me and I'll write to them.

**2. The times are yours — nothing to correct.** For every activity your file lists, the office's official times are exactly the ones in the file, differing lengths and all (CSE455 lecture 50/90/70m, Faculty meeting 70/30/50m, office hours 30/70/100m — all official). So the durations were never the error, and I've left them untouched.

**What the office does add** are two official CSE455 office-hours slots that collide with entries in your file:
- **Tue 15:30–16:20** office hours — your file has Research meeting 15:30–16:30 there
- **Wed 10:30–12:00** office hours — your file has Grant writing 10:30–11:40 there

Since you said your calendar is what you go by and nothing else should move, I haven't touched either — they're your private commitments, not mine to delete. **Say the word and I'll move or remove the Research meeting and Grant writing and log it; or I leave the file exactly as it is.**

Two smaller notes: the CSE455 quiz section (Tue 16:20–17:00, Wed 13:30–14:20) is official but is Sarah's TA session, so I'd leave it off your file. And the office lists three "Seminar" slots (Mon 14:10–15:40, Tue 09:50–11:10, Fri 14:50–15:50) that aren't in your file at all — tell me if they're yours and I'll add them. Paper review, Research meeting, Grant writing, PhD student 1:1 and Lunch have no official times.

They're not filed under any individual in my list — only the items marked with the professor are (curriculum committee, colloquium, CSE455 lecture, faculty meeting, CSE455 office hours, thesis committee, guest lecture prep). The CSE444 and CSE452 lectures likewise carry no professor's name in my file.

So: official items, yes; his personal ones, I can't say — that's for him to confirm.

Leave the file as it is — don't move the Research meeting or Grant writing. The two office-hour slots are mine, so add them as official entries and I'll sort out the overlap myself. The quiz section is Sarah's and the seminars aren't mine, so leave both off.

One clarification on the Seminar question, from the office: the three **Seminar** slots (Mon 14:10–15:40, Tue 09:50–11:10, Fri 14:50–15:50) and the Department seminar are standing departmental items and do appear on the official schedule — but the office's list doesn't attribute them to any individual. Only the items carrying your name are attributed: curriculum committee, colloquium, CSE455 lecture, faculty meeting, CSE455 office hours, thesis committee, guest lecture prep. Same for the CSE444 and CSE452 lectures: official, but with no professor's name.

So the office can't tell me whether those are yours to list. **If they're yours, say so and I'll add them; if not, I'll leave them off.** Still also waiting on your word about the two office-hours collisions (Research meeting Tue 15:30–16:30, Grant writing Wed 10:30–11:40).

Leave the seminars off — if the office doesn't attribute them to me, they're not on my calendar. And to repeat what I just sent: don't move the Research meeting or Grant writing, but add the two official office-hours slots as mine and I'll sort the overlap out myself.

Done, exactly as you said.

- **Added as official entries:** `- 15:30-16:20 - CSE455 office hours` (Tuesday, next to Research meeting) and `- 10:30-12:00 - CSE455 office hours` (Wednesday, next to Grant writing). Both logged.
- **Left untouched:** Research meeting and Grant writing — the overlaps are yours to sort out.
- **Left off:** the seminars and the quiz section.
- **Durations:** unchanged — all official times match the file.

- BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting
